name: Relephon
description: Relephon was a gas giant in the Hapes Cluster orbited by the Relephon Moons, of which several were populated.
lead_paragraphs: Relephon was a gas giant in the Hapes Cluster orbited by the Relephon Moons, of which several were populated.
In 40 ABY Relephon's military forces under Ducha AlGray spearheaded a coup against Queen Mother Tenel Ka Djo.
